[1/1] Add prefab-instance badges and an instance count to the console hierarchy

impact_assessment.why: Linked prefab roots are visible in the inspector but indistinguishable in the hierarchy list, unlike Unity/Unreal prefab markers.
impact_assessment.benefits: Hierarchy rows show prefab name and instance prefix, filters match them, and the status line reports the instance count.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: no API or schema change; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: display-only.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Derive badges from prefab_link, add static assertions, run node --check and the full gate cycle.

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Hierarchy prefab badges and instance count implemented; 732 tests green, node --check clean, AIKit 6/6; checklists: passed
Task 'keystone-hierarchy-prefab-badges-v1' completed successfully.
[1/2] Plan prefab-link fields in structured scene diffs

impact_assessment.why: Scene diffs compare transforms, visibility and components but ignore editor-only prefab links, so AI clients miss link changes.
impact_assessment.benefits: diff_scene reports prefab link changes per node, keeping saved-scene comparisons accurate for prefab workflows.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: diff document schema bump; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no persistence change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add the field to node diffing, bump the diff schema, test added/removed/changed links, and run the full gate cycle.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Scene diffs report prefab_link changes with diff schema 2; 733 tests green, AIKit 6/6; checklists: passed
Task 'keystone-scene-diff-prefab-links-v1' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan multi-root prefab instance groups: link every inserted root, revert/apply whole groups, preserve sibling order

impact_assessment.why: Only single-root prefabs get instance links, so multi-root prefabs cannot be reverted or applied as a unit.
impact_assessment.benefits: Every inserted root carries the prefab link, group revert restores the whole template in place, group apply captures all roots into a multi-root prefab, and each operation stays one undo entry.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: no REST or schema change; dependency: none; concurrency: existing editor lock; state: group roots must share a parent, sibling order must be preserved, and manual duplicates must not reuse a link.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add a group helper that validates one parent, order roots by the parent's child list, clear links on manual node duplicates, and add insert/revert/apply/undo regressions.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Multi-root prefab groups implemented: every root linked, group revert/apply, instance-prefix stripping, distinct group count, split-group 400; 735 tests green, node --check clean, determinism hash 772cac5232a0947b8f6d1914a5cf0cde, headless/describe schema 21, AIKit 6/6; checklists: passed
Task 'keystone-multi-root-prefabs-v1' completed successfully.
[1/2] Plan atomic delete and reparent for multi-root prefab instance groups

impact_assessment.why: Deleting or reparenting one linked root could split a multi-root group and make later revert/apply fail.
impact_assessment.benefits: Deleting a linked root removes the whole group, reparenting moves all roots together, moves into the group are rejected, and each operation stays one undo entry.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: no REST or schema change; dependency: none; concurrency: existing editor lock; state: group roots must share a parent and delete/reparent must not leave partial links.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Reuse the group helper, reject moves into the group, cover reparent/delete/undo, and run the full gate cycle.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Atomic group delete/reparent implemented with move-into-group rejection and undo coverage; 736 tests green, determinism hash 772cac5232a0947b8f6d1914a5cf0cde, headless/describe schema 21, AIKit 6/6; checklists: passed
Task 'keystone-prefab-group-integrity-v1' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan nested prefab instances with prefab schema 2, prefix/ID rebasing on instantiate, and capture/revert/apply coverage

impact_assessment.why: Prefab capture and instantiation flatten nested instances, so nested prefab assets cannot be composed, reverted or applied.
impact_assessment.benefits: Prefab documents persist nested links with a v1 migration, insertion rebases nested prefixes and IDs, and nested groups support revert/apply without disturbing the outer instance.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: prefab schema 2 and editor schema 22; dependency: none; concurrency: existing editor lock; state: prefix rebasing, ID uniqueness, direct self-reference and dangling nested assets.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Normalize template IDs and links during capture, rebase effective prefixes during instantiate, reject self-links and root links, test v1 migration and nested workflows, then run the full gate cycle.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Nested prefabs implemented: prefab schema 2 with schema-1 migration, parent-relative link normalization, outer.inner prefix/ID rebasing, nested and outer revert/apply; 740 tests green, node check clean, determinism hash 772cac5232a0947b8f6d1914a5cf0cde, headless/describe schema 22, AIKit 6/6; checklists: passed
Task 'keystone-nested-prefabs-v1' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan per-property prefab override detection, editor exposure, and per-field revert/apply actions

impact_assessment.why: Instances can diverge from their prefab templates, but the editor exposes only whole-instance revert/apply, so AI and human users cannot see or resolve individual overrides.
impact_assessment.benefits: A deterministic prefab_overrides report lists template/instance field differences, and revert_prefab_override/apply_prefab_override resolve one field with undo for scene edits and library-safe prefab writes for applies.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: editor schema 23 and two new actions; dependency: none; concurrency: existing editor lock; state: field mapping across roots/children, nested group boundaries, component presence, and atomic library writes.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Map template and instance trees structurally, skip nested boundaries, compare stable field values, validate the field against the live report, clone templates for applies, and add override/revert/apply/undo/library tests.
